preconditions.description: The number of rows in the matrix must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of columns in the matrix must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell in {0, 1} for cell in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must be either 0 (landmine) or 1 (safe).

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if not any(matrix[i][0] == 1 for i in range(len(matrix))) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no safe cells in the first column, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if not any(matrix[i][-1] == 1 for i in range(len(matrix))) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no safe cells in the last column, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(length) if length >= 0 else True
postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the shortest safe route if a path exists.
